## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for sun protection
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops
- Light jacket or sweater for cool evenings

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotions and aloe vera
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel-sized shampoo and conditioner
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Basic first aid kit

### Electronics
- Travel charger and power bank
- Portable speaker
- Camera or phone

### Miscellaneous
- Beach umbrella or parasol
- Sunhat or wide-brimmed hat
- Water shoes or sandals
- Travel-sized laundry bag
- Travel insurance documents
- Passport and ID
- Travel adapter
- Snorkel and mask
- Beach chair or mat
- Towel and beach bag
- Travel journal or notebook
